name: jev-gate
description: One Claude Code plugin from the jev-gate repository: evidence search, extractive compaction, Vitest log folding, a Jev effort and model router, and an orchestration gate. Gate, Compact, Output, and the Router are on by default, and each of those four has a switch. Evidence has no switch. gateMode off does not turn the others off.

plugins.name: jev-gate
plugins.description: Evidence search, extractive compaction, Vitest log folding, a Jev effort and model router, and an orchestration gate, in one install. Gate, Compact, Output, and the Router are on by default, and each of those four has a switch. Evidence has no switch. Needs Node 22. A TypeSafe key is separate from a Claude login. The plugin configures Function Hooks automatically for compaction, folding, and routing.
